scope: TOL-005 exact-head bounded/redacted Tool-result retention on disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO.

observations.coverage: A bounded redacted Artifact is readable through the authorized public route; oversized output fails without a retained Artifact/object or public raw value.
observations.limitations: No protected sandbox, provider, browser, Stack, Firecracker, or Linux/KVM is exercised.

redaction: No artifact body, raw output, identifiers, DSNs, credentials, or endpoints are retained.
